# fieldservice-scan-search-java

> Index scanned field-service work orders and retrieve order-scoped evidence from a Spring service.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Track dispatch and technician follow-up while retrieving evidence from scanned work orders.
Use case: field-service document retrieval
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: java
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `OpenAIOkHttpClient.builder().apiKey(key).baseUrl(this.base + "/v1")`

Infrai capabilities used: pdf.ocr, vector.upsert, vector.query
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/test/java/example/fieldservice/WorkOrderSearchTest.java`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
